After uploading the domain data to BloodHound, I notice our compromised user a.harris has GenericAll over the i.park user:

This means we can force change password, perform targeted Kerberoast, or even add Shadow Credentials.

I also noticed the i.park can change the passwords of svc_web and svc_ca users due to the ForceChangePassword privilege:

I just changed the password of the user i.park using the privileges of a.harris account to Pwned123:

This means we can request Welcome-Template template, supply our own alternative name, and obtain a certificate as that user like the domain administrator.

Firstly, I requested the Welcome-Template and specified the alternative username along with the SID of the domain administrator:

└─$ certipy-ad req -u svc_ca@welcome.local -p 'Pwned123' -ca WELCOME-CA -template Welcome-Template -upn Administrator -dc-ip 10.1.78.144 -sid S-1-5-21-141921413-1529318470-1830575104-500 -target 10.1.78.144 -debug
